class.name: NNDotProductVector3SearchCriterion
class.brief_description: Scores and filters based on the dot product between [member dot_product_vector] and the search space node direction.
class.description: The [Vector3] dot product search criterion scores and filters [Node3D] candidates based on the dot product between [member dot_product_vector] and the node's forward direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]). When used for scoring, the raw score is computed as [code]dot * 0.5 + 0.5[/code] (mapping [code]-1.0..1.0[/code] to [code]0.0..1.0[/code] for normalized vectors), then passed through [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.activation_curve] if one is set.

members.member: Direction compared against each candidate's forward direction ([code]-global_transform.basis.z[/code]). Should be normalised.

How the dot product is compared to [member filtering_value] when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code]: [code]LessThan:0[/code], [code]LessOrEqual:1[/code], [code]Equal:2[/code], [code]MoreOrEqual:3[/code], or [code]MoreThan:4[/code]. Nodes for which the comparison is [code]true[/code] are filtered out (for example, with [code]LessThan[/code], any node whose dot product is less than [member filtering_value] is filtered out).
Dot product threshold (typically in [code]-1.0..1.0[/code]) compared using [member filtering_rule] when [member NNNQSSearchCriteria.use_for_filtering] is [code]true[/code].
